notes.title: 🎉“No-good Streamer Mirai-chan!” Now Available on Steam!🎉
notes.content:
Hello, this is Muneniku Tabetai!

We're excited to announce that “No-good Streamer Mirai-chan!” is officially released on Steam today!

This game was born from a simple (and maybe a bit naughty) desire: “Wouldn’t it be fun to have sexy chats with a cute streamer girl?”
Given the nature of the game, we expected the localization to be quite a challenge—but we did our best so players outside of Japan can enjoy it too!

Be sure to send lots of comments to Mirai-chan!
And if you’re curious, there’s a free demo available as well—give it a try and see what the game is all about!
If you’ve played the game, leaving a review would make the development team very happy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591500/_/

Thanks for your support, and see you next time!
